Add direct-helper and full-agent PRIVATE_SENTINEL tests covering FinBERT, VADER, fusion, selected-attempt status and fusion polarity. Prove the marker is absent from the typed slot, compact summary, lifecycle/log/progress/trace/Sentry serialization, while the slot remains explicitly degraded. Preserve all valid one-model/fusion/low-coverage behavior, attempt=3/stage06-r1-a3 identity, eight measured boundaries, temporal/MCP fixes and immutable model provenance.
